work.name: Ktransformers
work.summary: Developing high-performance heterogeneous operators for Ktransformers, an open-source library for efficient transformer models.

education.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC)

publications.name: KTransformers: Unleashing the Full Potential of CPU/GPU Hybrid Inference for MoE Models
publications.publisher: SOSP '25 (ACM SIGOPS 31st Symposium on Operating Systems Principles)
publications.summary: We introduce KTransformers, a CPU/GPU hybrid inference system designed for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models; via heterogeneous operator optimization, KV-cache management, and load balancing, it significantly boosts throughput while maintaining low latency

projects.name: Ktransformers
projects.summary: Ktransformers is a novel approach to optimizing transformer models for efficient inference on hybrid CPU/GPU architectures.
